Scientists announced a new discovery about a single living cell, which looks similar to the ancient DNA from human embryos. That is probably because of the use of new nan. One of the most promising discoveries was that one tiny cell produces a DNA molecule with another DNA molecule, or nucleus. This does not seem like such a complicated sequence. To find a DNA molecule, scientists thought the cell must have an RNA molecules, which can provide an enzyme.
